title: AIIMS Jodhpur Notification 2026 - Walk-in-Interview for Various Project Nurse III Posts
description: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Jodhpur (AIIMS Jodhpur) has declared the official notification for the recruitment of various Project Nurse III Jobs.
